units.source_text: 的确，河童和人类的恋爱方式完全不同。

en.t: Indeed, the way kappa fall in love is completely different from the way humans do.

units.source_text: 雌河童一旦对某只雄河童中了情，就会想方设法去抓它。

en.t: Once a female kappa falls for a particular male kappa, she will do everything she can to catch him.

units.source_text: 即便是最老实的雌河童，也会不择手段的追求自己中意的雄河童。

en.t: Even the most gentle female kappa will use any means necessary to pursue the male kappa she has taken a fancy to.

units.source_text: 我就目睹过一只雌河童痴迷疯狂的追一只雄河童。

en.t: I once saw a female kappa chasing a male kappa in a crazed frenzy of obsession.

units.source_text: 不光是这样，小雌河童自己去追无可厚非，可是她的父母兄弟也会一起去帮着追呢。

en.t: And that is not all; it may be understandable for a young female kappa to do the chasing herself, but her parents and brothers will join in and help chase him too.

units.source_text: 雄河童真是让人同情，它玩命地逃，就算幸运没被抓到，也要大病二三个月。

en.t: The male kappa is truly pitiable: he flees for his life, and even if he is lucky enough not to be caught, he will be seriously ill for two or three months.

units.source_text: 有一次，我在家里看托喀的诗集。

en.t: One day, I was at home reading Tok's collection of poems.

units.source_text: 突然河童拉卟翻了个跟头跑起来，累的倒在床上，气喘吁吁地说：“完蛋啦！

en.t: Suddenly the kappa Lapp turned a somersault and broke into a run, then collapsed exhausted onto the bed and gasped, "I am done for!
Someone has grabbed hold of me!"
